bookwriter.button.paste.tooltip: Import the clipboard across as many pages as it needs (Ctrl+Shift+V)
bookwriter.button.link.tooltip: Import the text of a web page
bookwriter.button.undo.tooltip: Put the book back the way it was before the last import
bookwriter.button.continue.tooltip: Import the text that did not fit in the last book
bookwriter.source.continued: Text left over from the last book
bookwriter.preview.title: Import Into Book
bookwriter.preview.range: Fills pages %s–%s. The book will have %s pages.

bookwriter.preview.overflow: %s more pages do not fit in this book. They are kept so you can continue in another book.

bookwriter.preview.nothing: There is no text to import.
bookwriter.mode.replace.tooltip: Throw away what is in the book and start from page 1
bookwriter.mode.insert.tooltip: Add new pages after the page you were on (or onto it, if it is blank)
bookwriter.mode.append.tooltip: Add new pages after the last page with text
bookwriter.tidy.tooltip: Remove invisible characters, trailing spaces and extra blank lines
bookwriter.link.title: Import From Link
bookwriter.link.hint: Web pages, Pastebin, Gists, text files and public Google Docs
bookwriter.error.bad_link: That does not look like a web link.
bookwriter.error.connect: Could not reach that site. Check the link and your connection.
bookwriter.error.timeout: The site took too long to answer.
bookwriter.error.forbidden: The site refused access (error %s). The page may need a login.
bookwriter.error.not_text: That link is not a text page (it may be an image, PDF or download).
bookwriter.error.empty: No readable text was found. The page may need JavaScript or a login.
